title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout
alternative_titles: ライザのアトリエ 〜常闇の女王と秘密の隠れ家〜
description: A coming-of-age role-playing game following Ryza and her friends through a summer adventure, combining exploration, material gathering, alchemical synthesis and real-time tactical battles.
similar_games: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book
Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy

player_sentiment.summary: Sampled original-game PS4 user reviews enjoy the relaxed atmosphere, characters and alchemy, while some find the story slow and repeated crafting or inventory management tedious; experiences vary.
